description:
Advances: specled.verification

Recommended by the consolidated critical review of specled_-jzx (0 Critical / 1 High / 2 Medium / 17 Low, 15 fix-now). Report:
~/vaults/rmbrs-vault/code_review/critical/specled_ex/2026-08-12/specled_-jzx-mdex-swap/20260812-191451-consolidated.md

Problem: a requirement can name a pinned configuration and still have nothing enforcing it. On specled_-jzx three of four declared MDEx extensions (strikethrough, autolink, tasklist) could be deleted from @markdown_options with the entire suite green. Two independent reviewers found this by hand-running mutations; nothing in the repo would have caught it. The same shape hid the missing language- class assertion and the missing syntax_highlight pin.

Proposal: a mix spec.mutate task that, for each key in a declared option list bound to a requirement, deletes the key, runs the tests tagged with that requirement id, and fails if none fail. Mechanical, deterministic, and it turns "the pinning is decorative" from a review finding into a build error.

Second half, same class: extend the doc identifier lint to negative-existence claims in CHANGELOG and ADR prose. specled_-jzx shipped "This surface previously had no requirement and no test coverage" when a pre-existing tagged test at test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:963 already covered part of it. That was the sixth instance across that ticket of prose claiming more than the evidence supports, and every one was caught by a grader rather than by a gate.

Severity: Medium. No current defect depends on it; the value is that it makes a recurring review finding unreportable. Sized as one task, not an epic.

comments.text:
Review-bar-override: this IS the gate proposal for a recurring review shape, not a
finding to fix inline — it needs its own design (how a declared option list binds to a
requirement id) and ships as a new mix task, which cannot land inside a dependency-swap
PR without ballooning its scope.

Rated Medium deliberately rather than inflated to clear the bar. No current defect
depends on it; every instance it would have caught on specled_-jzx was fixed on that
branch before merge. Its value is preventing the seventh instance, not repairing the
first six.

If it goes stale, dropping it is a legitimate outcome — the class it guards is already
visible to any reviewer who runs a mutation by hand, which is how it was found twice.

title: mix spec.mutate: fail a build when a pinned option list has no test behind it
